tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bsrung ba lnga'i lha mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro kun dga' mdzad thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rtser// yon tan nor bu gdul bya'i dpal gyur pa// bla ma bzang po'i zhabs la gus btud de// rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams la bstod par bgyi// gzugs phung gnas gyur gti mug rnam dag pa// me long ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku// rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi rigs las byung*// so sor 'brang ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ston zla ltar gsal zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma// g.yas zhal char sprin lta bur cher gnag cing*// rgyab zhal gser mdog g.yon zhal dza ba'i mdangs// gtsug tor mchod rten gyis brgyan phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen gyis spras bcu drug lon pa'i tshul// 'khor lo rdo rje mda' dang ral gri g.yas// zhags pa rtse gsum gzhu dang dgra sta rnams// g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdong bzhi zhi ba dga' byed gos ser can// mkha' lding klu dbang gnon sbyin dri za dang*// mi'am ci yi tshogs kyis gus mchod ma// byang chub shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs zhags pa'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*// gzhan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas sbyor dang*// byad stems 'byed dang drag shul las rnams kun// rab tu 'joms ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog mchod la mngon par brtson pa dang*// brtse bas gzhan don gcig tu lhur len zhing*// theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams// yongs su skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam shes gnas gyur zhe sdang rnam dag pa// chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi rigs las byung*// stong chen rab 'joms zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma// g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar rgyab zhal ser// g.yon zhal ljang zhing zhal rer spyan gsum ldan// rngam pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri g.yas// zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub dgra sta gzhu// rin chen 'bar ba g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams// stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi mar rol pas bgegs dang 'byung po mnan// ma mo bdun dang srin mo sha za mo// gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu skrag mdzad pa// tā la'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa'i nad sel zhing*// thog dang ser ba rlung sogs gnod pa 'joms// dus min 'chi ba nges par zlog mdzad pa// 'jigs byed khro mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// tshor ba gnas gyur ser sna rnam dag pa// mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rigs las byung*// rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gser bzangs mdog mtshungs zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma// g.yas zhal mig sman ltar gnag g.yon pa dmar// padma zla bar sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog sbyin bum pa 'khor lo ral gri g.yas// dge slong dang bcas lhung bzed rma bya'i sgro// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bum pa dang*// rgyal mtshan g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bden pa grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyis mchod// srin mo'i tshogs 'joms klu rnams skrag mdzad cing*// lha ma yin rnams kun tu rmongs byed pa// mya ngan med pa'i shing drung bzhugs la 'dud// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams rab 'joms shing*// dmod pa'i mda' dang 'khrul 'khor 'jig par byed// sgrub po dri med bde la 'god mdzad pa// rig sngags rgyal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'du shes gnas gyur 'dod chags rnam dag pa// kun rtog ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rigs las byung*// gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhal gsum ma// g.yas gnag g.yon pa kunda zla ba'i mdog

/spyan gsum padma rgyas 'dras 'gro la gzigs// rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu gnyis phyag gi dang po chos 'chad tshul// gnyis pa mnyam gzhag mchog sbyin mi 'jigs sbyin// rdo rje mda' g.yas g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags// bum pa snye ma gzhu yis brel la 'dud// 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs mchod cing*// rgyal chen bzhi yis rtag tu rim gror byed// rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gus btud pa// shir shi'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pas rnam rol zhing*// sngags kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin// lha dang lha min klu dbang tshogs rnams kun// dbang du mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'du byed gnas gyur phrag dog rnam dag pa// bya grub ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rigs las byung*// bsil ba'i tshal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gsum phyag drug margad mdog mtshungs pa// g.yas dkar g.yon zhal karṇi ka yi mdog /rin chen 'od 'phro du mas rnam par brgyan// sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas mi 'jigs sbyin dang rdo rje mda'// g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub dang*// rin chen rgyal mtshan dang ni gnam ru 'dzin// dpa' mo dgyes dgur spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis mchod cing*// smyo byed brjed byed la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs// kun tu skrag mdzad bya yi gdon rnams 'joms// tsam pa'i shing drug pa zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug pa dang*// bskrad dang dbye dang gsad la sogs pa yi// las rnams thams cad so sor stsol mdzad pa// don kun sgrub byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog tu dad pa'i yid kyis bskul gyur nas// rab tu bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa las// nye bar bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des// bstod bya'i yon tan bdag la rdzogs gyur cig

/gang gis tshul 'dis rtag tu bstod byed na// de yi rgyud la lha mo de dag gi /ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pa 'jug gyur cing*// phyogs rnams kun la rtag tu rgyal bar 'gyur// bstod tshig 'di ni blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang pos me sbrul nag pa'i zla ba yi// tshes bcu'i nyin par mi dbang ga pa la'i// pho brang chen por legs par sbyar ba'o// lha mo lnga'i bstod pa ste gsum pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
